basis: Defined by global developmental delay and intellectual disability; facial dysmorphism does not establish another damaged organ.
Fungal infection directly involving the lungs.
Umbrella of inborn tyrosine metabolism disorders; additional organ damage is subtype dependent.
Carcinoma originating in the lung; asbestos exposure does not establish additional organ involvement.
Both fibrolamellar and conventional hepatocellular carcinoma components originate in the liver.
Primary osteoporosis with reduced bone mineral density; ocular disease cannot be inferred from LRP5 alone.
Immunodeficiency defined by deficient T-cell development and lymphopenia; other organ manifestations are occasional or separate infections.
Congenital malformation of pulmonary venous drainage; pulmonary hypertension is vascular, and dyspnea alone does not establish lung damage.
Axonal peripheral neuropathy; vocal cord paresis causes airway dysfunction in 8/8, and persistent pes cavus affects the locomotor system in 6/8.
Inherited keratinization disorder with persistent skin plaques and erythema in 8/8.
UV-associated skin injury; phototoxicity is not inherently immune mediated, although the definition also includes photoallergic reactions.
Ileal tumor; extrahepatic cholestasis and arterial occlusion each reported in 30-79%, supporting biliary and vascular damage; flushing is transient and anemia separately coded.
Intellectual disability defines disease; strabismus affects ocular alignment in 2/5 (40%); joint hypermobility alone does not establish musculoskeletal damage.
Bipolar mood disorder susceptibility; purely psychiatric disease has no axis despite its neurological ancestry.
Carcinoma originating in renal parenchyma; no additional organ damage meeting the frequency threshold is established.
Primary ovarian endocrine failure with amenorrhea and elevated FSH; gonadal hormone failure belongs to the endocrine axis.
Mitochondrial energy metabolism defect; dystonia and motor delay indicate neurologic dysfunction in 1/1; skeletal muscle atrophy and scoliosis also occur in 1/1.
Definition establishes defective alveolar development and atelectasis; the venous anomaly ancestry does not establish a cardiac lesion.
Nonsyndromic sensorineural hearing loss, reported in 4/4.
Germ cell malignancy originating in the reproductive testis; endocrine dysfunction is not established.
Defined congenital glycosylation defect, an inborn metabolic disorder; no specific additional organ phenotype is supplied.
Inherited qualitative plasminogen defect affecting fibrinolysis; thrombotic risk alone does not establish cardiovascular damage.
Carcinoma originating in a uterine reproductive ligament; this is outside the locomotor connective tissue axis.
Neurodevelopmental umbrella defined by intellectual and language impairment; cardiac and other abnormalities are subtype dependent.
Organic acid metabolism defect; developmental delay and CNS malformations in 1/1; retinal mottling alone does not establish dysfunction, and cataract frequency is unknown.
